name: boto3
description: A lightweight Python library for interacting with AWS services.
rationale: Boto3 is a local-first alternative to AWS SDKs, offering a more straightforward and efficient way to interact with AWS resources. By building this tool locally, developers can avoid the overhead of cloud-based dependencies and focus on writing code that works seamlessly with their infrastructure.
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
